47248-the-heroic-record-of-the-british-n.description: A book by Archibald Hurd. It was early on the morning of July 20, 1914, that a couple of guests, who had courteously been invited to be present in the gunboat _Niger_ for the King's inspection of the Fleet, made their way through the sleeping streets toward Portsmouth Dockyard. arxiv-2006-03651.title: A provably stable neural network Turing Machine
arxiv-2006-03651.creator:
ame John Stogin* \email jstogin@gmail.com, 
ame Ankur Mali* \email ankurarjunmali@usf.edu, 
ame Lee Giles \email clg20@psu.edu
arxiv-2006-03651.description: Abstract We introduce a neural stack architecture, including a differentiable parametrized stack operator that approximates stack push and pop operations for suitable choices of parameters that explicitly represents a stack. We prove the stability of this stack architecture: after arbitrarily many stack operations, the state of the neural stack still closely resembles the state of the discrete stack.

arxiv-2111-10629.title: The Theory of Efficient Particle Acceleration at Shocks
arxiv-2111-10629.creator: Pasquale Blasi
arxiv-2111-10629.description: Abstract The recent discoveries in the theory of diffusive shock acceleration (DSA) that stem from first-principle kinetic plasma simulations are discussed. When ion acceleration is efficient, the back-reaction of non-thermal particles and self-generated magnetic fields becomes prominent and leads to both enhanced shock compression and particle spectra significantly softer than those predicted by the standard test-particle DSA theory.

arxiv-2301-13478.title: A survey on the Hausdorff dimension of intersections
arxiv-2301-13478.creator: Pertti Mattila
arxiv-2301-13478.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pertti Mattila. Let A A and B B be Borel subsets of the Euclidean n n -space with dim A + dim B > n \dim A+\dim B>n . This is a survey on the question: what can we say about the Hausdorff dimension of the intersections A ∩ ( g ⁡ ( B ) + z ) A\cap(g(B)+z) for generic orthogonal transformations g g and translations by z z .

arxiv-2404-11711.title: The topological complexity of the ordered configuration space of disks in a strip
arxiv-2404-11711.creator: Nicholas Wawrykow
arxiv-2404-11711.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Wawrykow. How hard is it to program n n robots to move about a long narrow aisle such that only w w of them can fit across the width of the aisle? In this paper, we answer that question by calculating the topological complexity of conf ​ ( n , w ) \text{conf}(n,w) , the ordered configuration space of open unit-diameter disks in the infinite strip of width w w .

arxiv-2406-19106.title: MINE GRAPH RULE : A New GQL Operator for Mining Association Rules in Property Graph Databases
arxiv-2406-19106.creator: Francesco Cambria, Francesco Invernici, Anna Bernasconi, Stefano Ceri
arxiv-2406-19106.description: Abstract Mining information from graph databases is becoming overly important. To approach this problem, current methods focus on identifying subgraphs with specific topologies; as of today, no work has been dedicated to jointly expressing the syntax and semantics of mining operations over rich property graphs.

arxiv-2410-16371.title: Universality in the Near-Side Energy-Energy Correlator
arxiv-2410-16371.creator: Xiaohui Liu, Werner Vogelsang, Feng Yuan, Hua Xing Zhu
arxiv-2410-16371.description: Abstract We investigate the energy-energy correlator (EEC) of hadrons produced on the same side in e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} annihilation or in leading jets in p ​ p pp collisions. We observe a remarkable universality of the correlator.

arxiv-2506-00336.title: Structured Column Subset Selection for Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design
arxiv-2506-00336.creator: Hugo Díaz, Arvind K. Saibaba, Srinivas Eswar, Vishwas Rao, Zichao Wendy Di
arxiv-2506-00336.description: Abstract We consider optimal experimental design (OED) for Bayesian inverse problems, where the experimental design variables have a certain multiway structure. Given d d different experimental variables with m i m_{i} choices per design variable 1 ≤ i ≤ d 1\leq i\leq d , the goal is to select k i ≤ m i k_{i}\leq m_{i} experiments per design variable.

arxiv-2506-13365.title: Isoperimetric Inequality on Manifolds with Quadratically Decaying Curvature
arxiv-2506-13365.creator: Dangyang He
arxiv-2506-13365.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate the reverse improvement property of Sobolev inequalities on manifolds with quadratically decaying Ricci curvature. Specifically, we establish conditions under which the uniform decay of the heat kernel implies the validity of an isoperimetric inequality. As an application, we demonstrate the existence of isoperimetric sets in generalized Grushin spaces.

arxiv-2601-08563.title: On the Interstellar Extinction Curve toward HD 93222, A Sightline with an Exceedingly Narrow 2175 Å \,{\rm\AA} Extinction Bump
arxiv-2601-08563.creator: Qian Wang, Aigen Li, and X.J. Yang
arxiv-2601-08563.description: Abstract The 2175 Å \,{\rm\AA} extinction bump, the most prominent spectral feature superimposed on the interstellar extinction curve, is widely seen in the interstellar medium (ISM) of the Milky Way and external galaxies, both near and far. While its central wavelength is remarkably stable and independent with environment, its width shows considerable variation and environmental dependence.

arxiv-2602-17263.title: Learning a Latent Pulse Shape Interface for Photoinjector Laser Systems
arxiv-2602-17263.creator: Alexander Klemps, Denis Ilia, Pradeep Kr. Banerjee, Ye Chen, Henrik Tünnermann, Nihat Ay
arxiv-2602-17263.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Alexander Klemps, Denis Ilia, Pradeep Kr. Banerjee, Ye Chen, Henrik Tünnermann, Nihat Ay. Controlling the longitudinal laser pulse shape in photoinjectors of Free-Electron Lasers is a powerful lever for optimizing electron beam quality, but systematic exploration of the vast design space is limited by the cost of brute-force pulse propagation simulations. We present a generative modeling framework based on Wasserstein Autoencoders to learn a differentiable latent interface between pulse shaping and downstream beam dynamics.

pmc-11478319.creator: Anna Jílková, Barbora Lampová, Ondřej Kádě, Lenka Kouřimská, Diana Chrpová, Iveta Kaiserová, Martin Matoulek, Fernando Cordido

pmc-12735772.title: Triple Burden of HIV, HBV and HDV in Adults with Childhood Parenterally Acquired Infections: A Romanian Single-Center Study
pmc-12735772.creator: Manuela Arbune, Alina-Viorica Iancu, Monica-Daniela Padurariu-Covit, Alina Plesea-Condratovici, Anca-Adriana Arbune, Catalin Plesea-Condratovici, Steven L Zeichner
pmc-12735772.description: Background: Co-infections with HIV, HBV, and HDV pose significant public health challenges, especially in populations exposed parenterally. Romania hosts a unique pediatric HIV cohort of individuals born 1987–1995 who acquired HIV iatrogenically. This study assessed the prevalence, hepatic impact, and management of HIV–HBV–HDV co-infection in 130 long-term survivors from Galați County. Methods: Patients underwent clinical, laboratory, and FibroScan assessments.

pmc-13018070.title: Whole Lung Irradiation in Ewing Sarcoma with Pulmonary Metastases: Critical Appraisal of Evolution, Evidence, and Future Pathways in Precision Oncology
pmc-13018070.creator: YuanYou Yang, Lu Xie, Jie Xu, Xin Sun, Gang Ren
pmc-13018070.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Opinion StatementBased on the cumulative evidence, we advocate for the continued use of whole lung irradiation (WLI) as an integral component of multimodal therapy for Ewing sarcoma patients with pulmonary metastases, particularly in those with isolated lung involvement. Modern cardiac-sparing techniques, such as intensity-modulated radiotherapy and proton therapy, should be prioritized to mitigate acute cardiopulmonary toxicity, despite the unknown long-term implications of the low-dose bath.

pmc-13055406.title: Risk Factors for Upper Urinary Tract Stone Recurrence: A Retrospective Study of 247 Patients
pmc-13055406.creator: Tong Wu, Chiyu Zhao, Shiyu Mao, Haimin Zhang
pmc-13055406.description: BackgroundUrolithiasis, as a common disease in urology, has high incidence and recurrence rates. Although there are various treatments and most patients can receive minimally invasive treatment such as ureteroscopic lithotripsy, the high recurrence rate still carries a large disease burden.

pmc-13065557.title: The Changing Spectrum of Cognitive Impairment in People with HIV; Establishment and Updates of the International HIV-Cognition Working Group
pmc-13065557.creator: Sam Nightingale
pmc-13065557.description: With the widespread availability of effective antiretroviral therapy, the spectrum of cognitive impairment in people with HIV has changed from a subcortical dementia to milder impairment. The 2007 criteria for HIV-associated neurocognitive disorders (HAND) provided a methodological approach to classify milder and asymptomatic forms. Research using these criteria found that around 45% of people with HIV had HAND.

pmc-13242307.title: Global land rush concentrates potential zoonotic spillover risk in the tropics
pmc-13242307.creator: Chuan Liao, Seongmin Shin, Katie Rohrbaugh, Nabin Pradhan, Elizabeth Ludwig, Zhenci Xu, Manuel Ruiz-Aravena, Shuai Zhou, Arun Agrawal
pmc-13242307.description: Global land-use change alters human-environment interactions in ways that can generate sustainability risks, including pathogen spillovers across species. Here we integrate global data on large-scale land transactions and zoonotic reservoir species distributions to assess their relationship with potential zoonotic spillover risk.

pmc-13259426.title: Post-Print Annealing of FDM-Printed Polylactic Acid: Mapping Strength, Crystallinity, and α′/α Polymorph Composition via a Replicated Taguchi L9 Design
pmc-13259426.creator: Walid M. Shewakh, Majed H. Moosa, Zainab Hussein Mohsein, Osama M. Irfan
pmc-13259426.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fused deposition modeling (FDM) of polylactic acid (PLA) produces parts whose weak interlayer bonding and low as-printed crystallinity limit their tensile performance. This work used a Taguchi L9 orthogonal array with five replicates per cell (n = 5; N = 45 annealed specimens plus five non-annealed controls) to study how annealing temperature (70, 80, and 90 °C) and holding time (40, 60, and 80 min) change the tensile response of a commercial PLA grade (eSUN PLA+) printed on a desktop FDM machine.

pmc-13265865.title: Consumer segmentation and drivers of egg purchasing behavior among emerging consumers in central Chile: The role of nutritional knowledge, production systems, and quality perception
pmc-13265865.creator: Paula Toro-Mujica
pmc-13265865.description: Egg consumer preferences are increasingly shaped by attributes beyond price, including perceived quality, nutritional value, and characteristics of the production system and production-related attributes. However, limited evidence is available on how these factors interact to define consumer profiles in Latin America.

pmc-13647883.creator: Huiping Ding, Shengnan Hao, Gengsheng He, Kuaile Zhao, Yiqun Ling
